caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of textile or fabric with alternating horizontal bands. The blue bands have a pattern consisting of irregular blue shapes resembling ovals, each with a smaller white dot in the center, and are evenly spaced on a beige background. Interspersed between the blue bands are wider beige bands featuring symmetrical floral arrangements. Each floral motif consists of green stems with small leaves and clusters of red and pink flowers, organized in a triangular or cone-like formation. The background of the entire composition is a plain, off-white color, and the edges of the textile are straight, with slight fraying visible at the bottom. The objects in the drawing are arranged in a repetitive and orderly manner, creating an alternating sequence of geometric and organic patterns.
title: Printed Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
